observations: Photo 0: side/angled view of a PS5 Slim console standing upright on a wooden surface, with a white DualSense controller leaning against it.
Photo 1: front view of the same white PS5 Slim console, same controller sitting beside it.
No power-on screen, no cables, no box, no serial number or model sticker visible in either photo.
Cannot confirm from these angles whether this is the disc or digital edition of the PS5 Slim.
Only one controller (pad) is visible; no second pad, no charging cable, no HDMI/power cable shown.
Background shows a framed poster and a wooden shelf — a home setting, not a shop, which is neutral information.

identity.model: PS5 Slim (exact edition unclear - disc vs digital)

claims.evidence: Photos show no visible scratches or damage on the two sides shown, but 'clean' as a condition claim cannot be confirmed without seeing all sides, vents, and ports closely.
A white DualSense controller is visible in both photo 0 and photo 1.

risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / for-parts condition

risks.risk: Disc edition vs digital edition (significant value difference)
risks.proof: A clear photo of the front face showing presence or absence of the disc slot, or any photo of the retail box/label
risks.if_unproven: priced as the lower-value digital edition

risks.risk: Missing accessories: power cable, HDMI cable, second controller, original box
risks.proof: A photo showing all included accessories laid out together
risks.if_unproven: priced as console + single pad only, no cables/box

risks.risk: Storage capacity and remaining health of the SSD unknown
risks.proof: A screenshot of the system storage settings screen
risks.if_unproven: priced at base/lowest common storage tier

risks.risk: Hidden cosmetic damage on unseen sides/back (ports, vents, bottom)

Clear photo of the front face to confirm disc slot presence (disc vs digital edition)
Photo of all accessories included (cables, box, extra pads) laid out together
Screenshot of system storage menu showing capacity
Close-up photos of back, bottom, and vents for cosmetic condition
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a Sony PS5 Slim console with one DualSense controller, but since no functional test, accessory set, or edition (disc/digital) is confirmed, it must be priced at worst case: untested, digital-edition-equivalent, single pad, no extras.
